pages.text: Progression tokens are the Iridescent Codex's currency for advancing tiers. There are three: $(bold)Codex Token I, II, and III$() — one for each tier transition.$(br2)You earn them through the four lanes — Engineering, Magic, Exploration, Combat — and bank them toward a threshold. Full details: $(l:icraft:progression/tier_gates)How You Advance$().

$(bold)Earning & Banking$()$(br2)Submit eligible materials, reagents, and loot with $(bold)/icraft codex submit$() — the Codex converts them into the token for your current tier. Boss kills, dimension entry, and chest finds grant tokens too.$(br2)$(bold)Thresholds:$() $(t2)500$() → Tier 2 · $(t3)1000$() → Tier 3 · $(t4)2000$() → Tier 4. Check progress with $(bold)/icraft codex balance$().

$(bold)Not to Be Confused With…$()$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Spoils$() (relics, boss materials, uniques) are loot, not currency — see $(l:icraft:progression/tier_skip)Spoils Aren't Currency$().$(li)$(bold)Reforging tokens$() (Basic / Advanced / Ultimate) are a separate Apotheosis item crafted from boss materials; they reroll affixes, not tiers.$(br2)Progression tokens do exactly one thing: move you up a tier.
